lines.par1: A parameter is one adjustable number, a knob the model can turn.
lines.par2: A large model has billions of them, all set by training.
lines.sc1: A million seconds is about twelve days. A billion seconds is about thirty two years.
lines.sc2: Seventy billion seconds is over two thousand years. That is how many knobs there are to set.
lines.mem1: Each parameter takes two bytes, so seventy billion is one hundred forty gigabytes.
lines.mem2: Too big for one laptop, so large models run on racks of specialised G P Us.
lines.outro: More parameters means more room for patterns, but good data and training matter too. Billions of knobs, tuned by learning.
